name: Herodias
role: Wife of Herod Antipas, who wanted John the Baptist dead
whenBasis: John's arrest and death, early in Jesus' ministry, from the fifteenth year of Tiberius (Luke 3:1).
summary: Wife of Herod Philip who married his brother Herod Antipas, a marriage John the Baptist condemned. She held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him, but Herod protected him. At Herod's birthday banquet her daughter danced, and when Herod promised her anything, Herodias told her to ask for the head of John the Baptist on a platter.
body: Mark says she could not kill John on her own because Herod feared him. Luke lists her among the evil things John rebuked Herod for.

later.text: Josephus says she was a granddaughter of Herod the Great, first married to his son Herod (not Philip the tetrarch), and names her daughter Salome.
When Antipas was exiled in AD 39, the emperor Gaius offered to let her keep her property; Josephus says she chose to go with her husband.
